import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import bootstrap

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv')

# Identify the column for 'Not Documented' responses
not_documented_column = 'Q10_ML_Documentation_Not_Documented'

# Filter out the '-77' values (missing data)
filtered_values = df[not_documented_column].replace('-77', np.nan).dropna()

# Identify the values that indicate 'not documented at all' (assumed to be 'not quoted')
not_documented_values = filtered_values[filtered_values == 'not quoted']

# Calculate the proportion of respondents who mentioned that requirements are not documented at all
proportion_not_documented = len(not_documented_values) / len(filtered_values)

# Perform bootstrapping to calculate the 95% confidence interval
bootstrap_result = bootstrap((filtered_values == 'not quoted').astype(int), np.mean, confidence_level=0.95, random_state=42)

# Extract the confidence interval
confidence_interval = bootstrap_result.confidence_interval

proportion_not_documented, confidence_interval

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import bootstrap

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv')

# Identify the column for 'Not Documented' responses
not_documented_column = 'Q10_ML_Documentation_Not_Documented'

# Filter out the '-77' values (missing data)
filtered_values = df[not_documented_column].replace('-77', np.nan).dropna()

# Convert the filtered values to a numeric array of 0s and 1s
not_documented_numeric = (filtered_values == 'not quoted').astype(int)

# Calculate the proportion of respondents who mentioned that requirements are not documented at all
proportion_not_documented = np.mean(not_documented_numeric)

# Perform bootstrapping to calculate the 95% confidence interval
bootstrap_result = bootstrap((not_documented_numeric,), np.mean, confidence_level=0.95, random_state=42)

# Extract the confidence interval
confidence_interval = bootstrap_result.confidence_interval

proportion_not_documented, confidence_interval
